nodes.name: US Federal Executive (Trump Administration)
nodes.summary:
Architect of the mercantilist tariff regime and controller of the AI-chip export valve (BIS/Commerce)
Stance: Tariffs are leverage paid by foreigners; AI supremacy is a national-security imperative; deals over rules
The US executive branch under President Donald Trump's second term, driving tariff and AI-chip policy by executive authority (IEEPA, Section 122/232/301, BIS/Commerce).

nodes.name: People's Republic of China
nodes.summary:
Rival mercantilist state controlling the rare-earth/magnet chokepoint and building a parallel AI/chip stack
Stance: Commitment to win-win trade and opposition to weaponizing supply chains while pursuing self-reliance
The Chinese party-state (State Council, MOFCOM) directing trade retaliation, rare-earth policy, and indigenous AI/chip development.

nodes.name: Nvidia
nodes.summary:
Dominant AI-accelerator designer whose chips are the contested asset at the center of the collision
Stance: Supports American AI leadership but lobbies to keep every market including China open; controls should be narrow
Nvidia, the dominant US designer of AI accelerator GPUs (H100/H200/H20/Blackwell) and the CUDA software ecosystem.

nodes.name: TSMC
nodes.summary:
Sole-scale leading-edge foundry gating every advanced AI chip; flagship of Western reshoring policy
Stance: Customer neutrality and commitment to Taiwan as tech heart, while hedging via a US footprint
TSMC, the Taiwanese contract foundry making the overwhelming majority of the world's leading-edge chips, with a $165B US (Arizona) commitment.

nodes.name: US Hyperscalers
nodes.summary:
Capital source and demand engine of the ~$700B/yr AI capex supercycle
Stance: AI demand is insatiable and spending is disciplined; owning the full stack is strategic
The four US cloud/AI platform giants (Amazon/AWS, Microsoft, Alphabet/Google, Meta) funding the ~$700B/yr AI infrastructure buildout, modeled as a bloc.

nodes.name: OpenAI/Stargate
nodes.summary:
Leading US frontier-model lab anchoring the largest single AI-infrastructure program ($500B Stargate)
Stance: Safe AGI for humanity while racing to lock up compute and sovereign geographic deals
OpenAI, the leading US frontier-model lab, and its flagship $500B Stargate data-center consortium with SoftBank and Oracle.

nodes.name: US Federal Reserve
nodes.summary:
Monetary anchor whose rate path gates AI financing and determines the macro landing
Stance: Data-dependent and apolitical; treats tariff price effects as arguably transitory
The US Federal Reserve (FOMC), the central bank setting policy rates amid tariff-driven inflation and an AI-capex boom.

nodes.name: European Union
nodes.summary:
Rule-maker and would-be third pole, caught between US tariffs and Chinese mineral coercion
Stance: Strategic autonomy and open trade, negotiating to avoid US tariffs while under-building compute
The European Union (Commission plus member states) as a trade bloc and rule-maker pursuing digital/strategic sovereignty via InvestAI.

nodes.name: US Congress & Supreme Court
nodes.summary:
Legal and legislative gate validating, voiding, or codifying the tariff and chip regime
Stance: Constitutional limits and separation of powers; SCOTUS ruled IEEPA does not authorize tariffs
The US legislative (Congress) and judicial (Supreme Court) branches that can validate, void, or codify the tariff/chip regime.

nodes.name: DeepSeek/Huawei/SMIC
nodes.summary:
China's efficient open-weight lab and domestic silicon backers challenging the export-control thesis
Stance: Open research and self-reliance; algorithmic efficiency beats brute-force compute hoarding
DeepSeek, the Chinese frontier-efficient open-weight AI lab, together with its domestic silicon backers Huawei (Ascend) and SMIC.

nodes.name: Taiwan (Government)
nodes.summary:
Steward of the silicon shield and home constraint on TSMC's overseas expansion
Stance: Preserve deterrence and keep leading-edge nodes at home while deepening US ties
Taiwan's government (ROC / MOEA), steward of the silicon shield and TSMC's home constraint.

nodes.name: South Korea chip complex
nodes.summary:
Dominant HBM and memory suppliers forming a hard chokepoint on every AI accelerator
Stance: Defend the memory franchise; allied-with-friction with US export policy
Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix, the dominant suppliers of high-bandwidth memory (HBM) essential to AI accelerators.

nodes.name: ASML
nodes.summary:
Sole supplier of EUV lithography, the ultimate upstream gate on leading-edge chips
Stance: Serves global demand within Dutch/EU and US export-control coordination
ASML Holding, the Dutch sole supplier of EUV lithography tools required for leading-edge chip manufacturing.

nodes.name: Global South/Connectors
nodes.summary:
Trade-diversion beneficiaries and sovereign-AI buyers hedging between the two blocs
Stance: Position as China+1 friend-shoring hubs and sovereign-compute buyers while avoiding picking sides
Middle-power connector economies (India, Vietnam, Mexico, Gulf states/UAE, Saudi Arabia/HUMAIN) capturing rerouted trade and sovereign-AI investment.

links.name: SANCTIONS
links.fact: Reciprocal tariffs (peak ~28%, settled >11% by Apr 2026) plus chip export controls on China (Yale Budget Lab; Brookings).

links.name: CONSTRAINS
links.fact: Rare-earth/gallium/germanium/magnet export controls used as retaliation and coercive leverage (Skillings; LinkedIn/rare-earth reporting).

links.name: PARTNERS_WITH
links.fact: Oct-Nov 2025 one-year truce: China suspends rare-earth controls and pledges soybeans; US eases tech controls (AInvest; SCMP).

links.name: REGULATES
links.fact: BIS licensing of H20/Blackwell to China; Dec 2025 25%-revenue-share deal on high-end chip sales (FDD; CRS R48642).

links.name: INFLUENCES
links.fact: Nvidia lobbied to preserve China market access and accepted the revenue-share to regain it (Brookings).

links.name: CUSTOMER_OF
links.fact: Sole-scale advanced-node fabrication at TSMC gates all Nvidia shipments (TSMC Arizona).

links.name: CUSTOMER_OF
links.fact: HBM from SK Hynix/Samsung is required for every accelerator.

links.name: CUSTOMER_OF
links.fact: GPU supply gates the ~$700B/yr buildout (CNBC Feb 2026).

links.name: COMPETES_WITH
links.fact: In-house ASICs (TPU/Trainium/MTIA/Maia) built to reduce Nvidia dependence.

links.name: FUNDS
links.fact: Microsoft (with SoftBank and Oracle) anchors the $500B Stargate consortium (AI Wiki Stargate).

links.name: COMPETES_WITH
links.fact: Closed-frontier versus open-efficient models competing for global adoption (Brookings).

links.name: BACKS
links.fact: State support of the indigenous AI/chip stack as a tech-sovereignty instrument.

links.name: SANCTIONS
links.fact: Export controls and entity-list additions aimed at capping Chinese compute (CRS R48642).

links.name: INVESTS_IN
links.fact: $165B Arizona commitment made under US industrial-policy pressure and incentives (CNBC Jan 2026; TSMC PR).

links.name: CONSTRAINS
links.fact: Home patron controlling leading-edge node retention (the silicon shield).

links.name: ALLY_OF
links.fact: Security alignment plus the 2026 US-Taiwan trade deal.

links.name: OPPOSES
links.fact: Coercion risk over the chip chokepoint; the dominant tail risk to the AI supply chain.

links.name: SUPPLIES
links.fact: EUV lithography tools required for leading-edge fabrication.

links.name: CONSTRAINS
links.fact: EUV denial to SMIC caps China's ability to close the advanced-node gap (via Dutch/US controls).

links.name: INFLUENCES
links.fact: Executive pressure on the Fed to ease amid tariff inflation.

links.name: CONSTRAINS
links.fact: Rate path sets the financing cost of the ~$700B capex boom (Reuters/Klement).

links.name: REGULATES
links.fact: SCOTUS 6-3 ruling struck down IEEPA tariffs Feb 20 2026, forcing statutory substitution (SCOTUS opinion; Tax Foundation).

links.name: REGULATES
links.fact: AI Act, DMA, and competition enforcement over US platform giants.

links.name: SANCTIONS
links.fact: US tariff pressure plus bilateral deals with the EU.

links.name: DEPENDS_ON
links.fact: Acute rare-earth/magnet dependence on China exposes the EU to coercion.

links.name: SUPPLIES
links.fact: Sovereign-AI data centers built for Gulf buyers (UAE Stargate; HUMAIN-NVIDIA).

links.name: CUSTOMER_OF
links.fact: OpenAI/Stargate procures GPUs from Nvidia in interlocking vendor-financing arrangements.

links.name: DEPENDS_ON
links.fact: TSMC's leading-edge processes depend on ASML EUV tools.
